purpose: Reusable promotion gate-checker: read ANY branch summary.json + its normal_trades.csv (standard asdict-Trade schema) and emit gate verdict + concentration + robustness + one-line PROMOTE/HOLD/REJECT. Analysis/code only; no backtests, no training, no live orders.

gate.rule: ALL present scenarios must pass ALL three sub-gates (monthly_geometric_net >= 0.05 AND max_drawdown >= -0.20 AND trades >= 30). A scenario missing from the summary is reported as missing, never assumed to pass.

concentration_rule.decision: FAIL (concentrated) if top3_months_share > 0.60 OR top1_month_share > 0.35 OR total_net <= 0; else PASS (diffuse). Method is v61 (scripts/opencode_r19e_monthattr.py): calendar-month zero-filled series, Gini = relative mean absolute difference, trade shares from net_pnl-sorted trades.

trade_concentration_notes.note: Trade-level shares are ADVISORY caveats only; they never flip the decision by themselves (month-level rule decides concentration verdict).

robustness.note: Informational: fee_drag_pp = normal_mo - fee_mo; exec_drop_pp = normal_mo - exec_mo; dd_margin = dd_max - |worst DD over present scenarios|; fee_slope = OLS d(monthly)/d(fee_rate) over sibling fee-tier branches when present (fee-ladder summaries), else null. Warn thresholds below are advisory caveats, not gates.

decision_rule.PROMOTE: gate overall PASS on all present scenarios AND concentration diffuse (PASS) AND total_net > 0.
decision_rule.REJECT: fills fail in ANY present scenario (incl. fills-exec-fail) OR concentration FAIL OR total_net <= 0.
decision_rule.HOLD: everything else (typically monthly-fail and/or dd-breach with fills intact and concentration diffuse: banked-leg territory, needs a monthly breakthrough, not dead).

fail_reason_tokens.monthly-fail: monthly_geometric_net < 0.05 in >=1 present scenario; per-scenario form monthly-fail(<scenario>).
fail_reason_tokens.dd-breach: max_drawdown < -0.20 in >=1 present scenario; per-scenario form dd-breach(<scenario>).

warnings: EXPLORATORY on the opened development interval only; not an independent test.
Drawdown is trade-candle-close sampled, not true mark-price or full intrabar drawdown.
Stop/timeout exits are market-like at the scenario fee, NOT guaranteed maker/limit fills.
Do not claim maker fill probability or queue position from OHLC alone.
